Root cause: ui.test.ts cloned index.html per test, and jsdom schedules <details> toggle dispatch as a 0ms setTimeout bound to the element. Between synchronous tests vitest awaits only microtasks, so the queue never reached its timer phase: every toggle task stayed pending and pinned its whole panel tree (~4.6MB per test, 700/700 alive after two full GCs), heap climbing monotonically to 4044MB against a 4144MB V8 limit and aborting the fork ~70 tests short — even alone on an idle machine. Fix: one real macrotask turn per test via afterEach setTimeout(0), which is what the browser would run between frames. Measured: 826/826 tests pass where 756 had; peak heap 1097MB in a healthy sawtooth vs monotonic 4044MB; file runs faster (19.6s vs 28.9s). Full-suite: 122/122 files, 5746/5746 tests, no worker abort. Per-fork heap cap rejected (moves the crash, doesn't fix the leak). docs/test-suite-memory.md records the evidence; CLAUDE.md Testing gains the rule. tsc/eslint/prettier clean.
